title: STANLEY IceFlow 2.0 Flip Straw Tumbler with Handle 30 oz | Twist On Lid and Flip Up Straw | Leakproof Water Bottle | Insulated Stainless Steel | BPA-Free | Dark Blossom
features: SIP FASTER, SPILL LESS: The Flip Straw 2.0 lid is designed for quick hydration. Just flip up to sip and snap it shut for a 100% leakproof seal. Perfect for your bag, commute, or workout.
COLD FOR 12 HOURS, ICED FOR DAYS: Stay refreshed wherever you go! Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps your drink cold for 12 hours or iced for up to 2 days, so you can hydrate longer without refills.

UPGRADED FOR ON-THE-GO: This tumbler is built for life in motion with an easy-carry handle and cupholder-compatible base. Whether you're running errands or heading to the gym, hydration is always within reach.
DURABLE, SUSTAINABLE, & EASY TO CLEAN: Made with 18/8 recycled stainless steel, this BPA-free tumbler is tough enough for everyday use and dishwasher safe for effortless cleaning.
DESIGNED FOR CONVENIENCE: The removable spout and replaceable seal make cleaning and maintenance a breeze, so your tumbler stays fresh and functional for years to come.
